title: commit-note.v1
description: One line of docs/roadmap/commit-notes.jsonl: the append-only journal that is this repo's high-frequency decision record. Structurally an ADR (claim, scope, impact, verification, evidence) serialized one per line rather than one per file. Until 2026-07-30 this contract existed only as imperative checks inside scripts/roadmap.mjs validate(); this file is the declarative statement of it. roadmap.mjs remains the enforcing authority -- it additionally checks cross-file invariants a schema cannot express (milestone ids must exist in valheim-volunteer-roadmap.json, ids must be unique across the file, `at` must be non-decreasing, and the secret/licence-wording scans).

schema_version.description: Pinned. roadmap.mjs rejects anything else outright.

id.description: Unique across the whole file. Uniqueness is cross-record, so it is enforced by roadmap.mjs, not here.

at.description: ISO timestamp. MUST be non-decreasing relative to the previous line -- the journal is an append-only chronological record, which is why a historical backfill is impossible without a contract change.

author.description: Explicit, because authorship is not inferable from git or filesystem metadata here -- agents commit as the user. Live values: codex, claude.

milestones.description: Every id must exist in docs/roadmap/valheim-volunteer-roadmap.json; roadmap.mjs enforces that join.

kind.description: Mirrors noteKinds in scripts/roadmap.mjs. `rollback` is declared with zero instances -- precedent that an unconsumed kind is legal, since `kind` is branched on nowhere and renders as a plain pill. Note there is deliberately NO `pending`: the journal is append-only while open questions are mutable, and no back-reference field exists to close one. Open questions live in DECISIONS-PENDING.md instead.

verification.description: How the claim was checked. Empty array is legal; empty strings are not.

evidence.description: Paths/links backing the claim. This is the field that makes an entry auditable rather than assertive.
